description: Collect the public followers and/or following lists of Facebook Pages and Profiles, including real cursor pagination, list-size transparency, search, and optional profile counts/contact/category enrichment. No login, cookies, or proxy setup required.

deduplicateRows.description: When enabled, each profileId/profileUrl is emitted once across all targets and modes (first occurrence wins). Per-target pagination duplicates are always removed.
deduplicateRows.title: Deduplicate rows across targets

includeProfileDetails.description: Adds row-level follower/following counts, category, email, phone, website, address, work, education, current city, and hometown when Facebook exposes them. Uses two opt-in GraphQL requests per row (header + light About) plus a profile-HTML fallback, all capped by maxItems. Off by default; absent fields are omitted, never fabricated.
includeProfileDetails.title: Include profile counts and contact details

maxItems.description: Hard cap on row records across all targets. The default is 50; the daily prefill uses 8. Set 8 to reproduce the old 8-row preview behavior.
maxItems.title: Maximum total rows

maxItemsPerTarget.description: Optional cap per target (0 = no per-target cap). Use it to stop one large account from using the whole maxItems budget.
maxItemsPerTarget.title: Maximum rows per target

mode.description: Which public list(s) to collect. 'both' collects Followers and Following. 'friends' is a legacy alias: Facebook does not expose Friends to logged-out visitors, so it returns the Followers collection with isFallback=true.
mode.title: Mode

searchQuery.description: Keep only accounts whose name contains this text (Facebook's own in-list search, case-insensitive substring). Empty means no filter; one-character queries are treated as no filter because Facebook ignores them.
searchQuery.title: Search inside the list

startUrls.description: One or more Facebook Page or Profile targets. Accepts full URLs, profile.php?id=..., /people/<name>/<id>/ (plus /followers, /following, /friends, or /both suffixes), /p/..., and URLs already ending in /followers, /following, or ?sk=... . The m/mobile/touch hosts are normalized to www. mbasic is rejected because it is login-gated, and groups/events/marketplace/media pages are not supported. Bare usernames are accepted by the actor; the Console URL-list editor expects a full URL.

url.description: A Facebook Page or Profile URL, profile.php?id=..., /people/... URL, or bare username.
url.title: URL

startUrls.title: Facebook Page or Profile URLs

title: Facebook Followers & Following Scraper Input
